candidates.title: Unlocking the Edge deployment and ondevice acceleration of multi-LoRA enabled one-for-all foundational LLM
candidates.reason: Hardware-aware on-device inference framework evaluated on Galaxy S24/S25 Qualcomm platforms; combines runtime LoRA switching without recompilation, multi-stream decoding, self-speculative decoding and INT4, reporting 4-6x overall memory/latency improvements across 9 languages and 8 tasks.

discovery_stats.axis: edge/mobile on-device runtime・multi-LoRA switching・self-speculative decoding
discovery_stats.query_summary: agentic KV cacheからedge/local inferenceへ切り替え、実機スマートフォン上のruntime最適化を探索した。2604.18655はGalaxy S24/S25実機評価を持ち、canonical ID/titleをdefault branchで再検索して未収録を確認した。
